The `.skip` attribute is on the `memoize` decorator itself (`funcy.memoize.skip`), not on the decorated function. The requirement says "Both memoize and cache decorators must support raising skip exceptions to bypass caching logic." This means users should be able to do `raise funcy.memoize.skip(some_value)` or `raise funcy.cache.skip(some_value)`.
